recent.title: Structured Fields Define Populations — Never Keyword-Match Free Text
recent.summary: Campaign population classification must use structured fields (Sequence Status, Pipeline Stage). Free-text keyword matching produced 3 different results for same population.

recent.title: UNREAD Is Not UNPROCESSED — Gmail State Is Not Business State
recent.summary: Gmail UNREAD label does not prove item requires action. Must verify CRM state before recommending customer action.

recent.title: Always Use Adelaide Timezone for Business Dates — Never UTC
recent.summary: CEO Brief displayed Monday when it was Tuesday in Adelaide. All user-facing dates must use Australia/Adelaide.

recent.title: Token Inventory Is Not Response Data — Infrastructure Is Not Engagement
recent.summary: 607 Campaign Tokens created. Only 2 Processed=True (backfill artifacts). Zero genuine customer link clicks. Token counts are not response metrics.

recent.title: Absence From Bulk Search Is Not Proof of No Send
recent.summary: Bulk Gmail search truncated at 150 results. Atlas@ token queried as james@, silently returning wrong mailbox. Direct recipient search + mailbox identity gate required.

business_knowledge.description: Permanent business principles from completed experiments and customer interactions.

principles.principle: Painters do not respond meaningfully to curiosity-led outreach about quote follow-up.
Trust and shared experience are stronger opening mechanisms than curiosity for trade business owners.
principles.evidence: Curiosity-led = 0 replies. FF1 launched as hypothesis.

principles.principle: Customers do not buy because we follow up. They buy because they become more confident.
Never trust a green tick. Every claim of external effect must be independently verified.
principles.evidence: 172 emails reported sent, 0 in Gmail Sent folder.

principles.principle: When a customer is waiting on a third party, remove the burden from them. Offer to check back.
principles.evidence: Customer stuck on insurer. 2-week check-in offered.

principles.principle: A lost job is not necessarily a lost customer. Thank them, preserve the relationship, leave the door open.
principles.evidence: Previous client lost on cost. Graceful close preserved relationship.

principles.principle: When the business has let a customer down, acknowledge it honestly. No excuses.
principles.evidence: Customer lost to delayed follow-up. Honest apology preserved goodwill.

principles.principle: Operational Ownership: Atlas never performs work that belongs to the client.
principles.evidence: Won deal. Client owns scheduling; Atlas owns customer care.

principles.principle: Acknowledge Before Handover. Customers should never wonder whether their email was received.
principles.evidence: Acknowledge, reassure, hand over. Not silence.

principles.principle: The Cost of Stopping Is Always Lower Than the Cost of Assuming.
principles.evidence: 172 undelivered + 32 false Email 2. 60-second verification would have prevented both.

principles.principle: Production Environments Must Prove They Are Healthy Before Operating.
principles.evidence: Two incidents from environment operating unverified. Production Readiness Check now mandatory.

principles.principle: Intelligence Escalation Framework: Escalate based on operational importance, not curiosity.
principles.source: Janis Tham / Civium, refined by James, Aug 2026

principles.principle: Reality Always Wins: The CRM must represent reality such that James never needs Gmail to understand state.
Expected Execution Is Not Verified Execution. PASS requires read-back evidence that the artefact exists.
principles.evidence: 4 emails sent but Messages missing. Workflow reported PASS on expectation, not evidence.

principles.principle: Gmail Sent Is Communication Truth. Only independent Gmail evidence proves customer communication occurred.
principles.evidence: 3 production incidents where API/script/Airtable diverged from Gmail reality.

principles.principle: Dashboard KPIs must use structured fields only. Free-text keyword matching produces non-reproducible results.
principles.source: Dashboard V2 campaign KPI correction, Aug 2026
principles.evidence: 3 different results (98, 104, 105) from Outreach Notes keyword matching. Structured fields = 99, always.

principles.principle: A failed query against an unverified base/table must never be generalised into 'service is down'.
principles.evidence: Querying wrong base ID produced 403. PAT was never broken. Verify expected vs actual base before diagnosing.

principles.principle: Campaign response data requires Processed=True evidence. Token inventory is not engagement.
principles.evidence: 607 tokens, 227 YES, zero Processed=True from genuine customer interaction.

production_incidents.description: Every incident strengthens the operating system.

recent.title: CEO Brief — Date Error + UNREAD vs UNPROCESSED
recent.root_cause: UTC date used without Adelaide timezone conversion. Gmail UNREAD state treated as proof of unprocessed action.
recent.resolution: Adelaide timezone rule, UNREAD vs UNPROCESSED rule, CEO Brief Freshness Gate permanently encoded in SOUL.md and ceo-brief-standard.md.
recent.learning: Never derive business date from UTC. Gmail state is not business state. CRM must verify before recommending action.

recent.title: Dashboard — 4-Day Dead Dashboard + Stale Tradies Table
recent.root_cause: dashboard-update.py referenced obsolete 'Tradies' table removed from production schema. No alerting on refresh failure.
recent.resolution: Dashboard V2 deployed with three-section architecture. Tradies/Quotes dependencies removed. Structured-field-only KPI contracts.
recent.learning: Stale architecture must be detected, not silently failing for days. Dashboard refresh failure must alert.

recent.title: RE-ENG — Campaign Tokens Table Missing at Launch
recent.root_cause: Campaign Tokens table did not exist when campaign sent. All 441 YES/NO/UNSUB links returned HTTP 500 for ~6 hours.
recent.resolution: Table created. 607 tokens backfilled. Response links functional. 2 Processed=True from backfill artifacts.
recent.learning: Token persist-before-send is mandatory. Never send without verifying token store exists and is reachable.

recent.title: RE-ENG — False '0 Sent' Report from Wrong Mailbox
recent.root_cause: Bulk Gmail search authenticated as atlas@ queried james@ mailbox — silently returned atlas@ data. Pagination truncation missed 3 deliveries.
recent.resolution: Mailbox Identity Gate mandatory before Gmail conclusions. Direct recipient search required for verification.
recent.learning: Absence from bulk search is not proof of no send. Verify mailbox identity before interpreting results.

recent.title: RE-ENG — 6 Duplicate Recipient Sends
recent.root_cause: Blind batch re-run without per-recipient idempotency check. 6 of 147 recipients received duplicate Email 1.
recent.resolution: Per-recipient campaign idempotency check deployed. Jay Duggin unsubscribed. 5 remaining duplicates acknowledged.
recent.learning: Never resend batch without per-recipient sent-check. Idempotency must be architectural.

recent.title: FF1 Wave 1 — 16 Duplicate Email 1 Sends
recent.root_cause: Blind batch re-run with no duplicate-send prevention
recent.resolution: 2-layer duplicate prevention. FF1 marked experimentally contaminated.
recent.learning: Retry must filter to eligible only.
